definitions.gloss: peak, summit, top of a mountain
definitions.explanation: The highest point of a mountain or elevation. A literary alternative to {山頂|さんちょう} or {頂上|ちょうじょう}.
The highest point or most intense moment of something — power, popularity, emotion, or any state. More commonly used than the literal mountain sense.

examples.english: Stand on the summit of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {登山家|とざんか}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、{絶頂|ぜっちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}した→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: The mountaineers pressed toward the summit in the blizzard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{険|けわ}しい→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧⟦{岩場|いわば}→岩場：27478_iwaba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}えて→越える：02099_koeru⟧、ついに{絶頂|ぜっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たどり{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: After crossing steep rocky terrain, they finally reached the summit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{絶頂|ぜっちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧だ。
examples.english: An idol at the height of popularity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶頂|ぜっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧だった。
examples.english: I felt like I was at the peak of happiness.

examples.japanese: ローマ⟦{帝国|ていこく}→帝国：12420_teikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶頂|ぜっちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The Roman Empire reached the zenith of its power in the 2nd century.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (peak, zenith) is more common than the literal mountain summit sense. Often used in the pattern ○○⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶頂|ぜっちょう} or ○○{絶頂|ぜっちょう} (at the peak of ○○).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧: summit, top (more common for mountains)
- ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧: mountain summit (specific to mountains)
- ⟦{最高潮|さいこうちょう}→最高潮：19278_saikouchou⟧: climax, high point (of excitement or events)
- ⟦{全盛期|ぜんせいき}→全盛期：11644_zenseiki⟧: heyday, golden age (focuses on the period)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{絶頂|ぜっちょう}: at the height of popularity
- ⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶頂|ぜっちょう}: peak of happiness
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶頂|ぜっちょう}: zenith of power
- {絶頂期|ぜっちょうき}: peak period
